This '''national electoral calendar for 2017''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2017 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

==January==
*5 November – 17 January: [[Elections in Somalia|Somalia]], [[2016 Somali parliamentary election|{{Nowrap|House of the People}}]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.saferworld.org.uk/downloads/somalias-2016-electoral-process---deom-report-final.pdf|title=Somalia's 2016 Electoral Process: Preliminary report of the Domestic Election Observer Mission|publisher=Saferworld, Punsaa and Soscensa, p. 6|date=March 2017|access-date=11 January 2020|archive-date=11 January 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200111014638/https://www.saferworld.org.uk/downloads/somalias-2016-electoral-process---deom-report-final.pdf|url-status=live}}</ref>
*23–31 January: ''[[Politics of Tokelau|Tokelau]], [[2017 Tokelauan general election|Legislature]]''
*29 January: [[Elections in Haiti|Haiti]], [[2015–16 Haitian parliamentary election|{{Nowrap|Chamber of Deputies (1/119 seats 2nd round)}}]] and [[Haitian Senate election, 2016–17|{{Nowrap|Senate (8/30 seats 2nd round)}}]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/world/americas/haiti/article129202769.html|title=Haiti election cycle nears end with Sunday vote and more than 5,000 seats up for grabs|work=[[Miami Herald]]|date=27 January 2017|access-date=11 January 2020|archive-date=27 January 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170127215108/http://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/world/americas/haiti/article129202769.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

==February==
*5 February: [[Elections in Liechtenstein|Liechtenstein]], [[2017 Liechtenstein general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.landtagswahlen.li|title=Landtagswahlen Liechtenstein|last=Regierung|first=Information und Kommunikation der|website=www.landtagswahlen.li|language=de|access-date=2017-07-13|archive-date=3 February 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210203160533/https://www.landtagswahlen.li/|url-status=live}}</ref>
*12 February: 
**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2017 Swiss referendums|Referendums]]
**[[Elections in Turkmenistan|Turkmenistan]], [[2017 Turkmen presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Turkmenistan Will Hold Presidential Election In February |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/turkmenistan-presidential-election-scheduled/28056168.html |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=15 October 2016 |access-date=16 October 2016 |archive-date=15 October 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161015215913/http://www.rferl.org/a/turkmenistan-presidential-election-scheduled/28056168.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
*19 February: [[Elections in Ecuador|Ecuador]], [[2017 Ecuadorian general election|President (1st round), Parliament]] and [[2017 Ecuadorian tax haven referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{cite web|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161123140432/http://www.ecuadortimes.net/2016/11/22/referendum-on-tax-havens-will-be-conducted-in-the-elections-of-2017/|url=http://www.ecuadortimes.net/2016/11/22/referendum-on-tax-havens-will-be-conducted-in-the-elections-of-2017/|title=Referendum on tax havens will be conducted in the elections of 2017|work=Ecuador Times|date=22 November 2016|archive-date=23 November 2016}}</ref>
*20 February: ''[[Elections in Artsakh|Nagorno-Karabakh]], [[2017 Nagorno-Karabakh constitutional referendum|{{Nowrap|Constitutional Referendum}}]]''<ref>{{cite news |title=Azerbaijan's Breakaway Nagorno-Karabakh Holds 'Illegal' Referendum |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/nagorno-karabakh-referendum-azerbaijan-armenia/28323000.html |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=21 February 2017 |access-date=23 February 2017 |archive-date=23 February 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170223040655/http://www.rferl.org/a/nagorno-karabakh-referendum-azerbaijan-armenia/28323000.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
*21 February: [[Elections in the Marshall Islands|Marshall Islands]], [[2017 Marshallese Constitutional Convention election|Constitutional Convention]]

==March==
*7 March: [[Politics of the Federated States of Micronesia|Federated States of Micronesia]], [[2017 Micronesian parliamentary election|Parliament]] and [[2017 Micronesian parliamentary election#Referendum|Referendum]]
*12 March: ''[[Elections in Abkhazia|Abkhazia]], [[2017 Abkhazian parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]''<ref>{{cite news |title=Georgia's Breakaway Region Of Abkhazia Holds Parliamentary Elections |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/georgia-abkhazia-parliamentary-elections/28364640.html |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=12 March 2017 |access-date=12 March 2017 |archive-date=12 March 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170312134458/http://www.rferl.org/a/georgia-abkhazia-parliamentary-elections/28364640.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
*15 March: [[Elections in the Netherlands|Netherlands]], [[2017 Dutch general election|House of Representatives]]
*19 March: 
**''[[Saint Barthélemy#Politics and government|Saint Barthélemy]], [[2017 Saint Barthélemy Territorial Council election|Legislature]]''
**''[[Collectivity of Saint Martin|Saint Martin]], [[2017 Saint Martin Territorial Council election|Legislature (1st round)]]''
**''[[Saint Pierre and Miquelon]], [[2017 Saint Pierre and Miquelon legislative election|Legislature]]''
*20 March: [[Elections in East Timor|East Timor]], [[2017 East Timorese presidential election|President]]<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/east-timor-to-hold-presidential-poll-in-march|title=East Timor to hold presidential poll in March|date=2017-01-18|work=[[The Straits Times]]|access-date=2017-07-13|archive-date=1 February 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170201234550/http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/east-timor-to-hold-presidential-poll-in-march|url-status=live}}</ref>
*26 March: 
**''[[Elections in Abkhazia|Abkhazia]], [[2017 Abkhazian parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]''<ref>{{cite news |title=EU, Georgia Shun 'So-Called Elections' In Breakaway Abkhazia |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/eu-georgia-abkhazia-elections-breakway/28366907.html |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=13 March 2017 |access-date=13 March 2017 |archive-date=13 March 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170313153039/http://www.rferl.org/a/eu-georgia-abkhazia-elections-breakway/28366907.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
**[[Elections in Bulgaria|Bulgaria]], [[2017 Bulgarian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.president.bg/news3557/darzhavniyat-glava-podpisa-ukaz-za-proizvezhdaneto-na-parlamentarni-izbori-na-26-mart-2017-g.html|title=Държавният глава подписа указ за произвеждането на парламентарни избори на 26 март 2017 г.|website=President.bg|access-date=2017-07-13|archive-date=27 January 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170127055523/https://www.president.bg/news3557/darzhavniyat-glava-podpisa-ukaz-za-proizvezhdaneto-na-parlamentarni-izbori-na-26-mart-2017-g.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
**''[[Collectivity of Saint Martin|Saint Martin]], [[2017 Saint Martin Territorial Council election|Legislature (2nd round)]]''
**''[[Politics of Wallis and Futuna|Wallis and Futuna]], [[2017 Wallis and Futuna Territorial Assembly election|Legislature]]''

==April==
*2 April: 
**[[Elections in Armenia|Armenia]], [[2017 Armenian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Ecuador|Ecuador]], [[2017 Ecuadorian general election|President (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Serbia|Serbia]], [[2017 Serbian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.b92.net/eng/news/politics.php?yyyy=2017&mm=02&dd=28&nav_id=100637|title=Serbia to hold presidential elections on April 2|work=[[B92]]|access-date=2017-07-13|language=en|archive-date=13 September 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180913112244/http://www.b92.net/eng/news/politics.php?yyyy=2017&mm=02&dd=28&nav_id=100637|url-status=live}}</ref>
*6 April: [[Elections in the Gambia|The Gambia]], [[2017 Gambian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*9 April: ''[[Elections in South Ossetia|South Ossetia]], [[2017 South Ossetian presidential election|President]] and [[2017 South Ossetian name change referendum|Referendum]]''<ref>{{cite news |title=U.S. Condemns South Ossetia Name-Change Referendum |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/u-s-condemn-south-ossetia-name-change-referendum/28310987.html |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=15 February 2017 |access-date=15 February 2017 |archive-date=15 February 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170215130532/http://www.rferl.org/a/u-s-condemn-south-ossetia-name-change-referendum/28310987.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
*16 April: [[Elections in Turkey|Turkey]], [[2017 Turkish constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.france24.com/en/20170210-turkey-sets-april-16-key-constitutional-referendum|title=Turkey sets April 16 for key constitutional referendum|work=[[France 24]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170211235514/http://www.france24.com/en/20170210-turkey-sets-april-16-key-constitutional-referendum |archive-date=11 February 2017 |url-status=dead |df=dmy-all }}</ref>
*23 April: [[Elections in France|France]], [[2017 French presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref name="France">{{Cite news|url=http://www.france24.com/en/20160504-france-sets-date-presidential-election-2017|title=French presidential election set for April 23 and May 7, 2017|date=4 May 2016|work=[[France 24]]|access-date=13 July 2017|language=en-US|archive-date=29 March 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170329235309/http://www.france24.com/en/20160504-france-sets-date-presidential-election-2017|url-status=live}}</ref>
*28 April: ''[[Curaçao]], [[2017 Curaçao general election|Legislature]]''

==May==
*4 May: [[Elections in Algeria|Algeria]], [[2017 Algerian legislative election|National Assembly]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Algeria to hold parliamentary election on May 4 |url=http://www.euronews.com/2017/02/02/algeria-to-hold-parliamentary-election-on-may-4 |date=2 February 2017 |agency=[[Euronews]] |access-date=10 February 2017 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170206185535/http://www.euronews.com/2017/02/02/algeria-to-hold-parliamentary-election-on-may-4 |archive-date=6 February 2017 |df=dmy-all }}</ref>
*6 May: ''[[Politics of Niue|Niue]], [[2017 Niuean general election|Legislature]]''
*7 May: [[Elections in France|France]], [[2017 French presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref name="France"/>
*9 May: [[Elections in South Korea|South Korea]], [[2017 South Korean presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news |title=South Korea calls presidential election for May 9 |url=https://www.ft.com/content/f42b7ab1-c55b-311f-bd22-2fe300ce298f |work=[[Financial Times]] |date=15 March 2017 |access-date=15 March 2017 |archive-date=16 March 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316024431/https://www.ft.com/content/f42b7ab1-c55b-311f-bd22-2fe300ce298f |url-status=live }}</ref>
*10 May: [[Elections in the Bahamas|The Bahamas]], [[2017 Bahamian general election|House of Assembly]]
*19 May: [[Elections in Iran|Iran]], [[2017 Iranian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://tass.ru/mezhdunarodnaya-panorama/3488846|title=Президентские выборы в Иране пройдут 19 мая 2017 года|work=[[TASS]]|access-date=13 July 2017|language=ru|archive-date=2 May 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502151848/http://tass.ru/mezhdunarodnaya-panorama/3488846|url-status=live}}</ref>
*21 May: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2017 Swiss referendums|Referendum]]
*24 May: ''[[Elections in the Cayman Islands|Cayman Islands]], [[2017 Caymanian general election|Legislature]]''

==June==
*3 June: 
**[[Elections in Lesotho|Lesotho]], [[2017 Lesotho general election|National Assembly]]
**[[Elections in Malta|Malta]], [[2017 Maltese general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Malta PM Joseph Muscat calls snap general election |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-39771645 |work=[[BBC News]] |date=1 May 2017 |access-date=3 May 2017 |archive-date=2 May 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502044519/http://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-39771645 |url-status=live }}</ref>
*8 June: [[Elections in the United Kingdom|United Kingdom]], [[2017 United Kingdom general election|House of Commons]]<ref>{{cite news |title=General election campaigning begins as MPs back June poll |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-39643804 |work=[[BBC News]] |date=19 April 2017 |access-date=20 April 2017 |archive-date=4 July 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170704022407/http://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-39643804 |url-status=live }}</ref>
*11 June: 
**[[Elections in France|France]], [[2017 French legislative election|National Assembly (1st round)]]
**''[[Elections in Kosovo|Kosovo]], [[2017 Kosovan parliamentary election|Parliament]]''<ref>{{cite news |title=Kosovo President Calls General Election For June 11 |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/kosovo-general-election-june-11/28480621.html |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=11 May 2017 |access-date=11 May 2017 |archive-date=11 May 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170511172316/https://www.rferl.org/a/kosovo-general-election-june-11/28480621.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
**''[[Elections in Puerto Rico|Puerto Rico]], [[2017 Puerto Rican status referendum|Referendum]]''<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.elnuevodia.com/noticias/politica/nota/ricardorossellooficializaelproximoplebiscitodestatus-2287669/|title=Ricardo Rosselló oficializa el próximo plebiscito de status|date=3 February 2017|work=[[El Nuevo Día]]|access-date=13 July 2017|language=es-pr|archive-date=3 February 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170203215658/http://www.elnuevodia.com/noticias/politica/nota/ricardorossellooficializaelproximoplebiscitodestatus-2287669/|url-status=live}}</ref>
*18 June: [[Elections in France|France]], [[2017 French legislative election|National Assembly (2nd round)]]
*24 June – 8 July: [[Elections in Papua New Guinea|Papua New Guinea]], [[2017 Papua New Guinean general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.pngec.gov.pg/news/2016/02/05/2017-national-and-llg-elections-dates|title=2017 National and LLG Elections Dates|publisher=Electoral Commission of Papua New Guinea|access-date=2017-07-13|archive-date=21 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190521074258/http://www.pngec.gov.pg/news/2016/02/05/2017-national-and-llg-elections-dates|url-status=dead}}</ref>
*25 June: [[Elections in Albania|Albania]], [[2017 Albanian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*26 June: [[Elections in Mongolia|Mongolia]], [[2017 Mongolian presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref>{{cite news |last1=Edwards |first1=Terrence |last2=Stanway |first2=David |title=No decisive winner in Mongolia presidential vote forces second round |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mongolia-elections-idUSKBN19H238 |work=[[Reuters]] |location=[[Ulaanbaatar]] |date=26 June 2017 |access-date=27 June 2017 |archive-date=27 June 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170627110747/http://www.reuters.com/article/us-mongolia-elections-idUSKBN19H238 |url-status=live }}</ref>

==July==
*7 July: [[Elections in Mongolia|Mongolia]], [[2017 Mongolian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/no-decisive-winner-in-mongolia-presidential-vote-forces-second-round|title=Mongolia to hold presidential runoff vote on July 9: Official|date=2017-06-27|work=[[The Straits Times]]|access-date=2017-07-13|archive-date=1 July 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170701085122/http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/no-decisive-winner-in-mongolia-presidential-vote-forces-second-round|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://asiarussia.ru/news/16815/|title=Mongolia's presidential election postponed to July 7|website=ARD|language=ru|date=30 June 2017|access-date=9 August 2020|archive-date=27 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201127170520/http://asiarussia.ru/news/16815/|url-status=live}}</ref>
*16 July: 
**[[Elections in the Republic of the Congo|Republic of the Congo]], [[2017 Republic of the Congo parliamentary election|National Assembly (1st round)]]<ref name="congo">{{cite web|url=http://fr.africanews.com/2017/05/13/congo-le-premier-tour-des-legislatives-fixe-au-16-juillet|language=fr|title=Congo: first round of legislative elections set for July 16|work=[[Africanews]]|date=16 May 2017|access-date=21 June 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170703215114/http://fr.africanews.com/2017/05/13/congo-le-premier-tour-des-legislatives-fixe-au-16-juillet/|archive-date=3 July 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Venezuela|Venezuela]], [[2017 Venezuelan referendum|Referendum]]
*18 July: ''[[Elections in Bermuda|Bermuda]], [[2017 Bermudian general election|House of Assembly]]''
*22 July: [[Elections in East Timor|East Timor]], [[2017 East Timorese parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://presidenciarepublica.tl/press-releasepresident-republic-calls-parliamentary-elections-22-july/?lang=en|title=Press Release: President of the Republic Calls Parliamentary Elections for 22 July|publisher=President of the Republic of Timor-Leste|date=3 May 2017|access-date=9 August 2020|archive-date=11 January 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220111190750/https://presidenciarepublica.tl/2017/05/press-releasepresident-republic-calls-parliamentary-elections-22-july/?lang=en|url-status=live}}</ref>
*30 July: 
**[[Elections in the Republic of the Congo|Republic of the Congo]], [[2017 Republic of the Congo parliamentary election|National Assembly (2nd round)]]<ref name="congo"/>
**[[Elections in Senegal|Senegal]], [[2017 Senegalese parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Venezuela|Venezuela]], [[2017 Venezuelan Constituent Assembly election|Constituent Assembly]]

==August==
*4 August: [[Elections in Rwanda|Rwanda]], [[2017 Rwandan presidential election|President]]
**[[Elections in Mauritania|Mauritania]], [[2017 Mauritanian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.jeuneafrique.com/446235/politique/mauritanie-report-referendum-constitutionnel-5-aout|title=Mauritania: Constitutional referendum postponed to 5 August|work=[[Jeune Afrique]]|date=9 June 2017|access-date=16 June 2017|archive-date=11 June 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170611162122/http://www.jeuneafrique.com/446235/politique/mauritanie-report-referendum-constitutionnel-5-aout/|url-status=live}}</ref>
*8 August: [[Elections in Kenya|Kenya]], [[2017 Kenyan general election|<s>President</s>]] (election nullified), [[2017 Kenyan general election|National Assembly and Senate]]
*23 August: [[Elections in Angola|Angola]], [[2017 Angolan legislative election|Parliament (1st phase)]]
*26 August: [[Elections in Angola|Angola]], [[2017 Angolan legislative election|Parliament (2nd phase)]]

==September==
*11 September: [[Elections in Norway|Norway]], [[2017 Norwegian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.regjeringen.no/no/aktuelt/valgdagen-blir-11.-september-2017/id2485486|title=Election Day will be September 11, 2017|publisher=Regjeringen|date=22 April 2016|access-date=9 August 2020|archive-date=23 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201023094403/https://www.regjeringen.no/no/aktuelt/valgdagen-blir-11.-september-2017/id2485486/|url-status=live}} {{in lang|no}}</ref>
*12 September – 7 November: [[Elections in Australia|Australia]], [[Australian Marriage Law Postal Survey|Referendum]]
*17 September: ''[[Elections in Macau|Macau]], [[2017 Macanese legislative election|Legislature]]''
*22 September: ''[[Elections in Aruba|Aruba]], [[2017 Aruban general election|Legislature]]''
*23 September: [[Elections in New Zealand|New Zealand]], [[2017 New Zealand general election|Parliament]]
*24 September: 
**[[Elections in Germany|Germany]], [[2017 German federal election|Bundestag]]
**[[Elections in Slovenia|Slovenia]], [[2017 Slovenian railway referendum|Referendum]]
**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2017 Swiss referendums|Referendums]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.news.admin.ch/de/nsb?id=66373|title=Voting templates for September 24, 2017|publisher=Switzerland Federal Council|access-date=18 April 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170707163854/https://www.news.admin.ch/de/nsb?id=66373|archive-date=7 July 2017|url-status=dead}} {{in lang|de}}</ref>

==October==
*10 October: [[Elections in Liberia|Liberia]], [[2017 Liberian general election|President (1st round) and House of Representatives]]<ref>{{cite news |last1=Butty |first1=James |title=Liberia's Former Foreign Minister Enters 2017 Presidential Race |url=https://www.voanews.com/a/liberia-former-foreign-minister-enters-presidential-race/3335198.html |work=[[Voice of America]] |date=18 May 2016 |access-date=7 November 2016 |archive-date=7 November 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161107155327/http://www.voanews.com/a/liberia-former-foreign-minister-enters-presidential-race/3335198.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
*15 October: 
**[[Elections in Austria|Austria]], [[2017 Austrian legislative election|National Council]]<ref>{{cite news|title=Neuwahlen in Österreich am 15. Oktober|url=https://www.faz.net/aktuell/politik/eilmeldung-neuwahlen-in-oesterreich-am-15-oktober-15018596.html|newspaper=[[Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung]]|language=de|date=16 May 2017|access-date=16 May 2017|archive-date=11 January 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220111190730/https://www.faz.net/aktuell/politik/ausland/neuwahlen-in-oesterreich-am-15-oktober-15018596.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyzstan]], [[2017 Kyrgyz presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news|title=Atambaev Says Kyrgyzstan To Hold Presidential Vote On October 15|url=https://www.rferl.org/a/kyrgyzstan-atambaev-presidential-election-october-15/28516045.html|work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]]|date=29 May 2017|access-date=29 May 2017|archive-date=19 August 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170819150822/https://www.rferl.org/a/kyrgyzstan-atambaev-presidential-election-october-15/28516045.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
*20–21 October: [[Elections in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2017 Czech legislative election|Chamber of Deputies]]
*22 October:
